root_cause: The locator '.todo-list li .toggle' timed out because the list item was not yet rendered in the DOM when the click was attempted. The 'Enter' keypress triggers an asynchronous React state update; the test did not wait for the new list item to appear before trying to interact with its toggle checkbox.
